conceptZh: 科學家老鼠與細長的長頸鹿互相模仿，慢一拍把長腿變成筆畫。
object: a bespectacled lab mouse and a skinny toy giraffe
morph: the giraffe copies the mouse a beat late, thin legs becoming the strokes of 瘦
creativeAngle: 長頸鹿慢一拍模仿老鼠，一高一矮，拉長的身形成了字。
promptEn:
An 8-second animated clip on a light mint-green lab backdrop. Lead: a bespectacled cartoon lab mouse in a tiny white coat with a clipboard. A skinny toy giraffe with thin legs copies every move one beat late. The finished glyph 瘦 is a saturated indigo-blue, centered, about 70% of frame height.
0.0-1.6s: the mouse tiptoes in with a measuring tape; one beat later the giraffe tiptoes in and the tape wraps around its neck instead. First "瘦" as the mouse freezes in a thin pose.
1.6-3.2s: copycat mix-up: the mouse bends, the giraffe bends later and bonks the mouse's hat; the mouse stretches up, the giraffe stretches even higher. Second "瘦" lands as the giraffe's thin legs cross like two strokes.
3.2-5.0s: the measuring tape whips around them and the tape marks spring into the glyph 瘦; both blink.
5.0-8.0s: HOLD, glyph perfectly still. At "瘦高" the giraffe stretches up past the top of the page edge, neck wobbling, and the mouse climbs on a stack of beakers to look it in the eye, whiskers twitching, away from the glyph.
Audio: Off-screen voice, warm and friendly, clear Taiwanese Mandarin, slow and distinct, reading exactly "瘦、瘦、瘦高" (ㄕㄡˋ、ㄕㄡˋ、ㄕㄡˋ ㄍㄠ) with clear tones: the character, a short pause, the character again, then the word once, and nothing after it. No subtitles or vocabulary text; the only text on screen is the single glyph 瘦.
No other text, no watermark, no flashing, no real people.

conceptZh: 賽車和太空人玩偶拿著細長的泡棉長條來一場友誼對決，一個衝過頭、一個飄上天各自揮空，轉回來「咚」地撞頭，飛出去的細長條掉在地上疊成「瘦」字，最後賽車把自己吸得瘦瘦的從太空人腳縫鑽過去。
object: two long, skinny crimson foam noodles held as fencing swords by the pull-back race car and the fishbowl-helmet astronaut toy
morph: after the head BONK both noodles fly out of their grips, flip and drop onto the mat, bending and stacking into the correctly formed glyph 瘦: one folds into the 疒 shelter at top left with its two small dots, the rest nest inside as 叟 with the bottom 又 landing last
creativeAngle: 與前版長頸鹿模仿秀完全不同，改成清楚的友誼對決實體笑點：武器是又細又長的泡棉條，呼應「瘦」的細長感；賽車拉回衝過頭、太空人揮劍時飄起來各自揮空，雙雙旋轉後撞頭，掉落的細長條疊成字。詞「瘦瘦」由賽車吸氣變成鉛筆般扁薄、側身鑽過太空人腳縫具體演出，字在最後三秒完全靜止。
promptEn:
An 8-second animated toy-slapstick clip on a pale butter-yellow play mat with one chalky white lane line, nothing else behind. Lead: 賽車, a squeaky pull-back toy race car with a slim teal body and big googly eyes on the windshield, who always overshoots and crashes nose first. Rival: a bouncy astronaut toy in a round fishbowl helmet who drifts off the ground at the wrong moment. Each holds a long, skinny crimson foam noodle like a fencing sword. The finished glyph 瘦 is solid saturated crimson, centered, about 70% of frame height with clear margins.

0.0–1.6s, the showdown: the car rolls in from the left, the astronaut bounces in from the right; they stop a car-length apart and raise their skinny noodles tip to tip. The car winds up by rolling backward with a long rubbery squeak, googly eyes narrowing; the astronaut bounces on tiptoe, helmet wobbling. First "瘦" at 0.9s as both noodles stand straight up, tall and thin.

1.6–3.4s, try and miss: the car releases and rockets forward with a huge noodle swing, overshoots completely, whooshes under the astronaut's noodle and skids all the way to the right edge, wheels spinning. In the same beat the astronaut swings with a giant wind-up but floats up off the mat mid-swing, slicing empty air. The momentum spins both of them like tops.

3.4–5.0s, the big BONK: both spin back toward center at once, freeze one beat eye to eye, then bump, car nose to fishbowl helmet, BOINK, with a bubbly squash-and-stretch wobble. The noodles fly out of their grips, flip high, and drop onto the mat, bending and stacking into the correctly formed glyph 瘦: one noodle folds into the 疒 shelter at top left with its two small dots, the rest nest inside as 叟, the bottom 又 strokes thumping down last. Second "瘦" at 4.6s as the final piece lands and the glyph snaps crisp and still.

5.0–8.0s, HOLD: the glyph stays perfectly still and readable at center. The car and astronaut sit dazed in the lower corners, tiny cartoon stars circling, then grin and shake wheel-to-glove below the glyph. At "瘦瘦" (about 6.2s) the car sucks in its sides until it is pencil-thin, squeezes sideways through the narrow gap between the astronaut's boots, and pops back to full width with a squeak, googly eyes spinning; the astronaut claps and drifts up a few centimeters, bonking softly on nothing. Nothing touches or covers the strokes.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "瘦、瘦、瘦瘦" (ㄕㄡˋ、ㄕㄡˋ、ㄕㄡˋ ㄕㄡˋ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones: the character, a short pause, the character again, then the word once, and nothing after it. Soft pull-back squeaks and one cartoon boink, all quieter than the voice. The only text on screen is the single glyph 瘦; no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no watermark, no flashing, no real people.
